in_hebrew.name: Goetz
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God's pledge or hostage
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Goetz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word 'Got', meaning 'God'. Goetz is a name given to a person who serves as a pledge or hostage for God. In feudal societies, a goetz was a knight or vassal who pledged loyalty and service to a lord.
